resources.string: There is no server key to check.

This is the first connection to this server. Compare the fingerprint below with the one the server\'s administrator gives you, for example the output of ssh-keygen -l on the server. Approving saves this key: if the server later presents another key, the connection stops.
Warning: this server\'s key has changed

The server presented a different key from the one you approved. Someone may be intercepting the connection (a man-in-the-middle attack). It can also happen after the server was reinstalled or its keys were replaced. The connection has been stopped. Accept the new key only if the server\'s administrator confirms the change.
Do this only if you have checked the new fingerprint with the server\'s administrator. An attacker in the middle could read everything you send to this server, passwords included.
The connection no longer waits for a decision on this key. Connect again to check it.
This server\'s profile no longer exists, so its key cannot be checked.
The approved server keys could not be read or saved. Nothing was changed.
The approved key changed while you were deciding. Nothing was replaced; connect again to check the key.
